title: [Mechanism study of Zhizi Dahuang Decoction in treating atherosclerosis based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation].
authors: Ruan, Li-Hua; Xu, Yi-Jia; He, Yao; Li, Jin-Tao; Long, Yun
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究栀子大黄汤治疗动脉粥样硬化的网络药理学与分子对接，对象为药物-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This paper investigated the effects and mechanisms of Zhizi Dahuang Decoction(ZZDHT) in treating atherosclerosis(AS) through a comprehensive approach combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo experiments. Active components and target sites of ZZDHT were identified and screened using TCMSP, SwissTargetPrediction, and SEA databases. AS-related target sites were obtained from GeneCards, OMIM, and TTD databases. Network pharmacology was employed to predict the core chemical constituents, core target sites, and potential mechanisms of ZZDHT in treating AS. Molecular docking was employed to evaluate their binding activity between the core components and targets. Core chemical components identified in ZZDHT included quercetin,(+)-dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol, luteolin, and 3',4',5,7-tetramethoxyflavone. KEGG enrichment pathways primarily encompass core targets such as Toll-like receptor 4(TLR4), nuclear factor-kappaB(NF-kappaB), interleukin(IL)-6, IL-1beta, and tumor necrosis factor(TNF). Molecular docking revealeda strong affinity between the core chemical components and these core targets. Forty male apolipoprotein E knockout(ApoE~(-/-)) mice were randomly assigned to a model group(MOD), low-dose ZZDHT group(ZZDH-L, 2.21 g.kg~(-1)), medium-dose ZZDHT group(ZZDH-M, 4.42 g.kg~(-1)), high-dose ZZDHT group(ZZDH-H, 8.84 g.kg~(-1)), and atorvastatin calcium group(ATO, 0.01 g.kg~(-1)). Additionally, C57BL/6J male mice served as the control group(CON), with 8 mice per group. CON was fed a normal diet, while the other groups were fed a high-fat diet to build an AS mouse model. All groups received corresponding drugs via oral gavage, and the CON and MOD administered an equal volume of 0.9% sodium chloride solution for 8 consecutive weeks. Experimental results showed that compared with MOD, ZZDHT intervention significantly inhibited aortic plaque formation in ApoE~(-/-) mice, reduced inflammatory infiltration at plaque sites, downregulated serum IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha levels while increasing IL-10 levels, thereby reshaping inflammatory homeostasis. Simultaneously, it regulated blood lipids by lowering serum total cholesterol(TC), triglycerides(TG), and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol(LDL-C) levels and increasing high-density lipoprotein cholesterol(HDL-C). qRT-PCR and Western blot confirmed that after treatment, the mRNA content of inducible nitric oxide synthase(iNOS) in aortic tissue decreased significantly, and the mRNA and protein expression of TLR4, myeloid differentiation primary response gene 88(MyD88), and NF-kappaB were all significantly reduced. Based on network pharmacology and experimental validation, ZZDHT may exert therapeutic effects on AS by modulating the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway to inhibit inflammatory responses, regulate blood lipids, reduce plaque lipid deposition, and enhance plaque stability.
abstract_zh: 本文通过网络药理学、分子对接和体内实验相结合的方法，研究了栀子大黄汤（ZZDHT）治疗动脉粥样硬化（AS）的作用及机制。利用TCMSP、SwissTargetPrediction和SEA数据库鉴定并筛选了ZZDHT的活性成分和作用靶点。从GeneCards、OMIM和TTD数据库获取AS相关靶点。采用网络药理学预测ZZDHT治疗AS的核心化学成分、核心靶点和潜在机制。采用分子对接评估核心成分与靶点之间的结合活性。ZZDHT中鉴定出的核心化学成分包括槲皮素（quercetin）、(+)-去氢双松柏醇（(+)-dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol）、木犀草素（luteolin）和3',4',5,7-四甲氧基黄酮（3',4',5,7-tetramethoxyflavone）。KEGG富集通路主要涵盖核心靶点，如Toll样受体4（TLR4）、核因子-κB（NF-κB）、白细胞介素（IL）-6、IL-1β和肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）。分子对接显示核心化学成分与这些核心靶点之间具有强亲和力。将40只雄性载脂蛋白E敲除（ApoE~(-/-)）小鼠随机分为模型组（MOD）、ZZDHT低剂量组（ZZDH-L，2.21 g·kg~(-1)）、ZZDHT中剂量组（ZZDH-M，4.42 g·kg~(-1)）、ZZDHT高剂量组（ZZDH-H，8.84 g·kg~(-1)）和阿托伐他汀钙组（ATO，0.01 g·kg~(-1)）。此外，C57BL/6J雄性小鼠作为对照组（CON），每组8只。CON组饲喂正常饮食，其他组饲喂高脂饮食以构建AS小鼠模型。所有组通过口服灌胃给予相应药物，CON和MOD组给予等体积0.9%氯化钠溶液，连续8周。实验结果显示，与MOD相比，ZZDHT干预显著抑制ApoE~(-/-)小鼠主动脉斑块形成，减少斑块部位炎症浸润，降低血清IL-6、IL-1β和TNF-α水平，同时增加IL-10水平，从而重塑炎症稳态。同时，它通过降低血清总胆固醇（TC）、甘油三酯（TG）和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）水平并增加高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（HDL-C）来调节血脂。qRT-PCR和Western blot证实，治疗后主动脉组织中诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）的mRNA含量显著降低，TLR4、髓样分化初级反应基因88（MyD88）和NF-κB的mRNA和蛋白表达均显著减少。基于网络药理学和实验验证，ZZDHT可能通过调节TLR4/NF-κB信号通路抑制炎症反应、调节血脂、减少斑块脂质沉积并增强斑块稳定性，从而发挥对AS的治疗作用。
